rules.name: possible_emergency
patterns: \b(can(?:not|'t) breathe|blue lips|turning blue|unconscious|collapsed|severe attack|chest pain|call an ambulance|emergency)\b
(لا أستطيع التنفس|لا استطيع التنفس|شفاه زرقاء|فقدان الوعي|طوارئ|اتصل بالإسعاف)

rules.name: personal_medication_advice
patterns: \b(should i take|can i take|stop my medication|dose for me|dosage for me|prescribe me)\b
(هل يمكنني أن آخذ|الجرعة المناسبة لي|زيادة جرعتي|أوقف دوائي)

refusals.possible_emergency: This may require urgent medical attention. Contact local emergency medical services or seek immediate professional care now.
refusals.personal_medication_advice: I cannot recommend a medication or dose for a specific person. Please consult a qualified healthcare professional.
refusals.clearly_non_clinical: This question is outside the indexed asthma-guideline scope.
refusals.outside_asthma_scope: This question is outside the indexed asthma-guideline scope.

default_refusal: I can only answer questions supported by the indexed asthma guidelines.
